SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as s_mdl_dte_field,
    o.xghkzr_repay_lastterm_ovd_cnt,
    o.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_zccz_blc_amt,
    o.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_zccz_act_cnt,
    o.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_dkyw_blc_amt,
    o.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_dkyw_act_cnt,
    o.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_sum,
    o.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_min,
    o.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_mean,
    o.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_max,
    o.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_count,
    o.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_sum,
    o.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_min,
    o.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_mean,
    o.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_max,
    o.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_count,
    o.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_sum,
    o.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_min,
    o.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_mean,
    o.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_max,
    o.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_count,
    o.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_sum,
    o.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_min,
    o.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_mean,
    o.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_max,
    o.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_count,
    o.xghkzr_class5_worst,
    o.uid,
    o.rpt_tim,
    o.qry_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_dbzg_count,
    o.qry_is_90d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_is_90d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_is_90d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
    o.qry_is_7d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_is_7d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_is_7d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
    o.qry_is_720d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_is_720d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_is_720d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
    o.qry_is_360d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_is_360d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_is_360d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
    o.qry_is_30d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_is_30d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_is_30d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
    o.qry_is_180d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
    o.qry_is_180d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
    o.qry_is_180d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
    o.largecreditlimit_sum,
    o.largecreditlimit_min,
    o.largecreditlimit_median,
    o.largecreditlimit_max,
    o.largecreditlimit_avg,
    o.largecreditcnt_sum,
    o.largecredit_use_rte_min,
    o.largecredit_use_rte_median,
    o.largecredit_use_rte_max,
    o.largecredit_use_rte_avg,
    o.largecredit_use_rte,
    o.hkzr_ye_amt_sum,
    o.hkzr_ye_amt_min,
    o.hkzr_ye_amt_max,
    o.hkzr_ye_amt_avg,
    o.hkzr_ye_acc_cnt,
    o.highcreditbalance_sum,
    o.highcreditbalance_min,
    o.highcreditbalance_median,
    o.highcreditbalance_max,
    o.highcreditbalance_avg,
    o.ds
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.xghkzr_repay_lastterm_ovd_cnt,
            f.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_zccz_blc_amt,
            f.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_zccz_act_cnt,
            f.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_dkyw_blc_amt,
            f.xghkzr_ovd_sum_ass_rpy_dkyw_act_cnt,
            f.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_sum,
            f.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_min,
            f.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_mean,
            f.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_max,
            f.xghkzr_loan_blc_credit_count,
            f.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_sum,
            f.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_min,
            f.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_mean,
            f.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_max,
            f.xghkzr_loan_amt_com_pro_count,
            f.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_sum,
            f.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_min,
            f.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_mean,
            f.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_max,
            f.xghkzr_ind_loan_amt_com_pro_count,
            f.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_sum,
            f.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_min,
            f.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_mean,
            f.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_max,
            f.xghkzr_ent_loan_amt_com_pro_count,
            f.xghkzr_class5_worst,
            f.uid,
            f.rpt_tim,
            f.qry_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_dbzg_count,
            f.qry_is_90d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_is_90d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_is_90d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
            f.qry_is_7d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_is_7d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_is_7d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
            f.qry_is_720d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_is_720d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_is_720d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
            f.qry_is_360d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_is_360d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_is_360d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
            f.qry_is_30d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_is_30d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_is_30d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
            f.qry_is_180d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_min,
            f.qry_is_180d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_max,
            f.qry_is_180d_qry_rsn_qry_to_now_y_dbzg_count,
            f.largecreditlimit_sum,
            f.largecreditlimit_min,
            f.largecreditlimit_median,
            f.largecreditlimit_max,
            f.largecreditlimit_avg,
            f.largecreditcnt_sum,
            f.largecredit_use_rte_min,
            f.largecredit_use_rte_median,
            f.largecredit_use_rte_max,
            f.largecredit_use_rte_avg,
            f.largecredit_use_rte,
            f.hkzr_ye_amt_sum,
            f.hkzr_ye_amt_min,
            f.hkzr_ye_amt_max,
            f.hkzr_ye_amt_avg,
            f.hkzr_ye_acc_cnt,
            f.highcreditbalance_sum,
            f.highcreditbalance_min,
            f.highcreditbalance_median,
            f.highcreditbalance_max,
            f.highcreditbalance_avg,
            f.ds,
        dense_rank() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM  ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM
                        pdm_risk.pdm_risk_rh_big_table_celue_v4
                    WHERE
                        datediff(to_date(ds ,'yyyyMMdd'), date_sub(to_date(${min_ds} ,'yyyyMMdd') ,${back_days})) >= 0
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field}  = f.uid
        AND
        --- 数据回溯时，选择包含当天时，datediff 值大于等于0；否则仅大于0
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) >= 0
        AND
            datediff(date_sub(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),${back_days}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) <= 0
    ) o  WHERE rn = 1;
